answer: The trend in the average number of AI-related sentences per 10-K filing from 2020 to 2024 shows a steady increase. In 2020, the average was 4.96 sentences, which rose to 5.98 in 2021, 6.25 in 2022, 7.48 in 2023, and reached 9.27 in 2024. This indicates that not only are more companies mentioning AI, but the prominence of AI in their disclosures is also growing.
